text:
jessica: Quick heads-up — ran a marketplace dry-run with Hradec Systems; their infra team flagged image signing and outbound egress ports. Can we eyeball before customer review?

devin: Thanks. What signing mechanism do they expect? Sigstore? notarization?

jessica: They want an image signature policy tied to a vendor KMS; prefer cosign + attestations. Also they said marketplace requires SHA256 manifest signing.

omar: We can support cosign. Need to confirm our private deployment build pipeline can publish signed artifacts to the marketplace registry. @paul can you check Packer/AMI signing?

paul: Yep. I can add cosign step. Two questions: 1) where to store keys (HSM vs Redwood KMS), 2) do we need image repro signatures for different regions?

lia: From CS: customer wants minimal downtime during push. Also they'd like a checklist for ports/whitelisting for the SI run.

devin: Port list we required last time:
```
443/tcp outbound (registry)
80/tcp outbound (health checks)
10250/tcp outbound (kubelet)
50051/tcp outbound (policy & agent)
``` 
Please confirm.

omar: Add 22/tcp for debug during the dry run (temp); otherwise keep locked.

jessica: Ops question — if keys live in customer HSM, we need a short step in the onboarding doc for automatic key rotation. Can someone draft?

paul: I'll mock a playbook and push to the SI repo today. Linking afterwards.

deploy-bot: Reminder — scheduled dry-run: 2025-07-14 16:00 UTC — created by jessica

lia: Great. I'll confirm the customer's firewall rules and sync on time zones. @devin can you prepare a one-page diagram for the architecture review?

devin: On it. Expect a diagram + dependency list by EOD.

jessica: Thanks all. If anything blocks, post here. :thumbsup:
